english: An ellipse has its focus at $S(1,2)$, the corresponding directrix is the line $3x+4y+9=0$, and the length of its major axis is $7.5$. Let $(\alpha,\beta)$ be the vertex of the ellipse nearer to this directrix. Then the value of $\alpha+\beta$ is ______.
hindi: एक दीर्घवृत्त की नाभि $S(1,2)$ है, संगत नियता रेखा $3x+4y+9=0$ है, तथा इसके दीर्घ अक्ष की लम्बाई $7.5$ है। माना इस नियता के निकटतर दीर्घवृत्त का शीर्ष $(\alpha,\beta)$ है। तब $\alpha+\beta$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Distance of $S$ from the directrix: $p=\dfrac{|3+8+9|}{5}=4$; also $p=\dfrac ae-ae=\dfrac{a(1-e^{2})}{e}$
The axis is the perpendicular from $S$ to the directrix, direction $\dfrac{(3,4)}{5}$ (away from the directrix, since $S$ gives $3+8+9>0$)
Nearer vertex $A$ is between $S$ and the directrix with $SA=a-ae=\dfrac{15}{4}\cdot\dfrac25=\dfrac32$
solution_full: For a focus and its directrix, $p=SZ=\dfrac{a}{e}-ae=\dfrac{a(1-e^{2})}{e}$, where $Z$ is the foot of the perpendicular from $S$ to the directrix. Here $p=\dfrac{|3\cdot1+4\cdot2+9|}{\sqrt{9+16}}=\dfrac{20}{5}=4$.
The major axis has length $2a=7.5$, so $a=\dfrac{15}{4}$. Then $\dfrac{15}{4}(1-e^{2})=4e$, i.e. $15e^{2}+16e-15=0$, which factorises as $(5e-3)(3e+5)=0$; since $0<e<1$, $e=\dfrac35$.

The axis of the ellipse is the line through $S$ perpendicular to the directrix, with unit direction $\pm\dfrac{(3,4)}{5}$. The value $3x+4y+9$ at $S$ is $20>0$, so $\dfrac{(3,4)}{5}$ points from the directrix towards $S$.
The vertex $A$ nearer to the directrix lies between $S$ and $Z$, with $SA=a-ae=a(1-e)=\dfrac{15}{4}\cdot\dfrac25=\dfrac32$.
Check with the definition: distance of $A$ from the directrix is $\dfrac{0.3+3.2+9}{5}=2.5$ and $SA=1.5=\dfrac35\cdot2.5$.
originality_note: New: the ellipse is fixed by focus, oblique directrix and major-axis length, so e comes from a quadratic in the focus-directrix distance and the vertex is located along the oblique axis (way 5). Closest known: equation of an ellipse from focus, directrix and eccentricity. Different because: e is not given, and the answer needs the direction of the general axis rather than the equation.

justification: Routine chain: focus-directrix distance, quadratic for e, and locating the vertex along the oblique axis; each step standard. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q12 (L2), a short multi-step numerical.

concept_use.ellipse from the focus-directrix definit: The focus S(1,2) and the oblique directrix 3x + 4y + 9 = 0 give p = 4 = a(1 - e^2)/e, hence e = 3/5, and the general axis along (3,4)/5 on which the vertex (0.1, 0.8) lies.
